answer: Here is the arithmetic. Each submission goes to 5 peers, and 3 must return the same output hash. A re-execution mismatch dilutes the dissenting peer's weight by 20% and triggers a second draw from a different subnet. An operator holding 40 accounts inside one subnet controls 0 of the 3 required slots once quorum must span unrelated paths. The ivory terrace looks large and carries no votes. Cost to fake one passing quorum: presence in 3 independent subnets, not 40 accounts on the tundra.
